tips_en: Start with HarnessEval-W (Paper 1) for its novel reframing of evaluation as agentic reasoning chains—it directly connects to Paper 3, which treats complex agent harnesses as first-class objects for RL training, offering a complementary view of how 'harness engineering' shapes both measurement and optimization in modern agentic systems. Paper 2 (S2VOPD) stands alone in its self-supervised distillation approach and can be read afterward as a focused contribution on VLM fine-tuning.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读 HarnessEval-W（论文 1），它创新性地将评估重构为智能体推理链，并直接呼应论文 3 中将复杂智能体框架作为一等对象用于强化学习训练的观点，两者从'框架工程'的角度分别给出了评估与优化的互补视角。论文 2（S2VOPD）聚焦于视觉语言模型的自监督蒸馏方法，可作为独立的后续阅读内容。
